text: The run is still going: it is tabbing through the page.
I'm waiting on the second run. It checks the tests that compare pages (9.A to 9.C and 19.A) against three other weather.gov pages. I'll also answer the open questions from the first run.

I could only settle part of weather.gov. Five criteria have results, and two of those are FAILs. The rest need a person.

- **Failed (2.4.1 Bypass Blocks):** The page opens with repeated header content ("National Weather Service" and others). The tool found no keyboard way to skip past it. Tabbing from the HOME link or the Location Help link did not move focus past that content.
- **Failed, but I doubt it (3.2.3 Consistent Navigation):** The tool says "Go" comes before the city/ZIP field on this page but after it on one of the other pages. That is a form control, not site navigation, so I'm reporting it as NEEDS_REVIEW instead of FAIL.
- **Passed:** 3.2.4 Consistent Identification and 2.4.5 Multiple Ways. These two used only the other pages I chose: /safety/, /about/ and /help/.
- **Does not apply:** 1.4.2 Audio Control and 2.3.1 Three Flashes. Nothing played audio or flashed during the observation window.
- **Needs review (2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide):** The moving/blinking check found nothing, but the auto-updating check could not finish.
- **Needs review, Tab walk incomplete:**
  - The Tab walk hit its 281-press limit before the end of the page.
  - The page has a large image map with many hidden links.
  - This leaves 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 3.2.1 and 3.2.2 unsettled.
  - Focus Order (2.4.3) is also unsettled, because I could not confirm the order is sensible. I answered that question "unsure" without opening the order image, and the tool rejected the answer.
- **Needs review, form-field checks not done:** The criteria are 1.3.1, 2.4.6, 3.2.2, 3.3.1, 3.3.2, 3.3.3, 3.3.4 and 4.1.2. The page has three form fields: a "Local forecast" text box, an "Enter Your City, ST or ZIP Code" box, and a "Remember Me" checkbox. Some fields are hidden until opened and were not checked. The error checks (3.3.1 and 3.3.3) need the live server's answers, which the tool could not get. I did not answer the 11 follow-up questions about the fields' labels. Both the "Remember Me" checkbox and the second text box sit in the green "Customize Your Weather.gov" box. The checkbox looks to have no clearly attached label text, but I haven't confirmed that.
